title: Evergreen
summary: EV'ERGREEN, adjective [ever and green.] Always green; verdant throughout the year. The pine is an evergreen tree. EV'ERGREEN, noun A plant that retains its verdure through all the seasons; as a garden

inlines.v: EV'ERGREEN, adjective [ever and green.] Always green; verdant throughout the year. The pine is an evergreen tree. EV'ERGREEN, noun A plant that retains its verdure through all the seasons; as a garden furnished with evergreens.
